source.title: dion
source.baseline: Mercenary III research baseline (pinned ST STX)

screen.flip: $5A93C: byte $42C01 -> $FF8201, then toggled; screens differ by $10000

rasterSplits.what: colour 8 = $7328 (land below the horizon), Timer B $53294

panelArt.source: DAM6 file head as loaded at $6D500 (game-entry image, PC $6AC32)

palette.note: colour 0 from the frame table ($72B0); colours 4 and 1(>=152) are the active card colours ($4D63C -> $6F12/$6F14 -> $539BA)

colours.note: $4D63C: first word -> $6F14 -> colour 1 from row 152 ($6FD20); second word -> $6F12 -> colour 4 ($6FD08); both XOR $70E8

steps: each VBL rows 160..190 of the box take rows 161..191 (scroll up one line)
count 32..1: row 191 takes the next new art line (line 0 first)
count 0: category 5 draws the card text ($4DF34)
reveal.refusesPanelInput: while the count is nonzero ($4D848, R1)

panel.drawer: $4ED8E: inverted glyph bytes, bits 4..0, ANDed as masks
panel.note: [ \ ] ^ hold A/O/U umlauts and sharp s

message.drawer: $53420/$535CA: bits 4..0 at cell x+1..x+5; row 0 is the accent row

messageBar.planes: ink in plane 0; planes 0 and 1 scroll
messageBar.motion: scrolls left 8 px per VBL, new byte at x 296..303; 4 characters per 3 VBL; 36 bytes per 48-character message; at count 37 the bar is copied to the other screen

location.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

coordinate.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink
coordinate.note: redrawn only when $4E5B0 changes; unchanged (0) in the slice, so the artwork placeholder +XXX XXX XXX stays

inventoryName.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

position.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

frame.rule: planes 0..2 clear, plane 3 set; row 174 plane 3 = $FFFC,$3FFF (dash, x 46..49 clear)

grid.source: X $70C2, Z $70CA; |v| clamped to 100; pair from $536DA
grid.rule: in box plane 0 clear, plane 3 set; v>=0 ink clears plane 3, v<0 ink sets plane 0

height.source: v = round($714A/16) as 16.16: 2 digits of int(v/65536), then the fraction times 100 twice; int >= 100 shows placeholder 10s; $7158 = $A forces that
height.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

cash.source: BCD $72DE..$72E4 (12 digits), first digit not shown
cash.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

cardText.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

clock.source: seconds $6FCE (wraps at 86400); HH-MM-SS, dashes are artwork
clock.rule: planes 0 and 1 set across each cell, cleared under ink

compass.rule: plane 3 at x = strip bit n + 1 + (x - 80)

pitch.source: $7154: s = ($7154 & $3F0) >> 4; rows s..s+19 of the strip
pitch.rule: planes 1 and 3 replaced by the strip words ($7EAEA, +4)

gauges.writer: $537E4 (per VBL, one row toward the value)
gauges.rule: a level L clears the planes in the bottom L rows

list.rule: plane 3 clear while $714A < $28FA on foot, else set
$6FF49 >= 0: plane 0 clear, plane 1 set; else swapped

lamps.note: unchanged from the artwork in every slice capture

refresh.order: location, grid, position, height, cash, coordinate, pitch, compass, lamp 2, lamp 1 (when $7122 != 2)

gaps: fonts: the 5-px card digit font at $4CBF6 (used by other card categories) is not decoded
fields.coordinate: the meaning of $4E5B0 is unknown; it is never drawn in the slice
fields.messageBar: text decoding ($53366 tokens) belongs to the message report, not here
fields: $7122 = 2 alternatives ($4E9E0 three-number readout, $4E4B2 height) are not decoded
